notes.title: Omensight: The Definitive Edition Is Out for PC, Soon for PS4 and Switch!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31655037/43188119dd9c53c20bd9c3bc0f3ce379c411e1f9.jpg[/img]

Hey all!

We’re back with another major (free!) update.

If you browse the Steam forums, you’ll see that there are many discussions about the ending of the game and the lack of option to revisit loops from previous acts. [b]Omensight: The Definitive Edition (a.k.a Update 1.04)[/b] addresses all that valuable feedback. Players who have finished the game already can simply jump right back in and experience this all-new post-ending content!

Playstation 4 owners will get this free update on [b]October 26th[/b].

As usual, you can see the complete patch notes over here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/455820/discussions/0/1693795812294061025/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31655037/b51144f8c73663281f949c0aec946ad330726783.jpg[/img]

In other news, [b]Omensight is coming to the Nintendo Switch![/b] Many have requested this and we were more than happy to oblige. We are currently hard at work on it and we expect a digital release in [b]November.[/b] So keep an eye for it!

[h1]Keep in touch![/h1]

If you want to be the first to know what Spearhead Games is up to, including our next project, please sign up to our [url=https://spearheadgames.us3.list-manage.com/subscribe/post?u=3533a72c174f5e970996c26b7&id=627c0a49fc]newsletter[/url] or join our [url=http://discord.gg/spearheadgames]Discord[/url] channel. We’re also on [url=http://www.facebook.com/SpearheadMtl]Facebook[/url] and [url=http://www.twitter.com/SpearheadMtl]Twitter[/url].

Thanks for playing Omensight!

Cheers,
Phil from Spearhead Games

notes.title: Update 1.03 Is Out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31655037/ff6d5803b9f40ec9695281c730040da6ed22eb08.jpg[/img]

Hey all!

We’ve got some major improvements in this update, most notably:
[list]
[*]Revamped platforming sections
[*]Split combat and investigation difficulty settings
[*]Integrated difficulty settings choice in-game
[*]Improved tutorials on how to use player abilities
[*]Tweaked enemies to not attack from off-screen
[*]Lowered requirement for Opportunist achievement
[*]Added 21:9 resolutions support
[*]Added option to hide HUD when the game is paused (photo mode)
[/list]

As usual, please check this post for more details:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/455820/discussions/0/1693795812294061025/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31655037/2e0b13255e6dbfa61d678ed3c674ca88332d0150.png[/img]

We now have our own Steam developer homepage! Please follow us to not miss out on any of our future releases and tell your friends about it.

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/spearheadgames/

It ain’t over for Omensight yet (far from it actually) so I’ll be back soon! Thanks for playing Omensight!

Cheers,
Phil from Spearhead Games

notes.title: Update 1.02 Is Out! Also, Soundtrack and Wishlist Quest Updates!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31655037/8926f02d9a1dc0c4eb50f22bb4ac6e05f695afbb.jpg[/img]

Hey!

Thanks for your patience but Update 1.02 is finally live! It addresses some major issues, notably:

[list]
[*]WASD control scheme
[*]Localization fixes
[*]Crash and loading screen freeze fixes
[/list]

For more details about what's in it, please check this post:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/455820/discussions/0/1693795812294061025/

There are more updates on the way so keep posting in the discussion board. We'll address all the feedback that we can!

Also, for those who bought the soundtrack before May 31st, the folder should have the .mp3 files now.

And finally, the final rewards for the Wishlist Quest have been sent out via email to all those who filled up the follow-up survey. Again, if there are any issues, please contact info@spearheadgames.ca or direct message me (SHG_Phil) on our [url=http://discord.gg/spearheadgames]Discord server[/url].

Cheers,
Phil from Spearhead Games
